sentences.text: The allegation against the accused No.3 is reflected in last paragraph of the first information report which shows that the accused No.3 performed indecent behavior in front of respondent No.2 in the month of July, 2022.
The first information report has been lodged on 22nd February 2023.
5. This Court has protected both the accused till today.
6. In order to place on record case diary and other material, stand over to 3rd July 2023.
7. On the next date of hearing, the anticipatory bail applications shall be decided finally.
8. Leave to amend to add victim as party respondent No.2.
Leave is also granted to annex documents.
Amendments to be carried out forthwith.

9. Issue notice to respondent No.2, returnable on 3rd July 2023.
10.
The respondent No.1 shall endeavour to serve respondent No.2 before the returnable date.
11. Till 3rd July 2023, ad-interim relief granted earlier by this Court is extended.
